CLINICAL FEATURES OF ANTERIOR UVEITIS
Clinical Features
- Blurring of vision
- Photophobia
- Pain may feature due to ciliary spasms.
- Exudation into anterior chamber
- Flare and cells
- Keratic precipitates on the corneal endothelium
- Subsequent posterior synechiae
- Miosis due to spasm of sphincter pupillae
